slides.headline: That decline reaches three counties
slides.body: The enrollment drop raises questions in Broward, Miami-Dade and Palm Beach counties.

slides.body: Miami-Dade had 2,701,767 residents in the 2020 census, making it Florida’s most populous county.

slides.body: Broward had 1,944,375 residents in the 2020 census, making it Florida’s second-most populous county.
